title: Repeat Kestrel Buyers — Goodwill Bonus Schedule
content:
A goodwill credit on a late fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts includes a repeat-buyer bonus, a flat dollar amount added to the credit, that follows the vehicles the borrower has bought from Kestrel, counted as the vehicle-price charges on the borrower's purchase orders (the borrower's Vehicle Purchase Agreements orders and their ledgers).

| Vehicles bought from Kestrel | Repeat-buyer bonus |
|---|---|
| three or more | three-vehicle goodwill bonus: 1.00 |
| exactly two | two-vehicle goodwill bonus: 0.50 |
| one | none |

## Counting

- Each vehicle-price charge on one of the borrower's purchase orders counts as one vehicle bought, whether or not that vehicle was financed with Kestrel Auto Finance.
- Hypothetical: a borrower with vehicle-price charges on three purchase orders takes 1.00; with two, 0.50; with only the purchase order this contract finances, none.
